responsibility: Implements -Wanalyzer-infinite-loop detection on the analyzer’s exploded graph. This file searches for cycles rooted at exploded nodes with CFG backedges, uses feasibility_state and constraint-aware edge filtering to require a single perpetually feasible successor path, rejects loops whose edges may perform useful work, and emits a dedicated pending_diagnostic with custom checker-path events and optional JSON/dot dumping to report loops whose exit conditions are unreachable in the analyzed state.
